subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 26, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - November 26, 2026

Good morning, and welcome to your Wednesday edition of the AcreetionOS daily update. We are a small, independent, community-driven project based in Spokane, Washington, and every commit you see here comes from two developers and a community that keeps us honest. Whether you have been with us since the early images or you just flashed your first ISO this week, thank you for being part of it.

In Development Updates, the focus over the past day has been polish rather than new features. Darren landed a pair of fixes to Fences, our window-management helper, first resolving a lingering resizing problem and then closing out yet another screen-related bug that had been reported by users. Anyone who noticed odd behavior when dragging or snapping windows should find things noticeably steadier after the next update.

The main acreetionos and acreetionos-xlibre repositories both received the same fix for a small but irritating issue: icons on the bottom panel were not reliably clickable. That correction has been mirrored across both branches so XLibre and standard users get the same behavior. A related round of general updating and repair work also went into the welcome-screen package, which is back to full health after some missing pieces were restored.

On the design side, Natalie pushed the initial commit for the acreetionos-wallpapers repository, which gives us a proper home for our wallpaper collection going forward. It is an early commit, but it establishes the structure we needed, and additional backgrounds will land there as they are polished. If you have ideas for wallpapers that fit the project, that repository is the place to watch.
